# Mechanix Wear

> > Mechanix Wear manufactures professional-grade work gloves featuring advanced protective technologies including TPR impact protection, Durahide leather, HPPE cut resistance, and D3O padding for industrial, construction, and specialized applications.

Mechanix Wear is a leading manufacturer of high-performance work gloves and hand protection solutions. Their product lines include the Original®, M-Pact®, SpeedKnit™, and specialized leather gloves, all engineered with proprietary materials and meeting ANSI and EN 388 safety standards for cut resistance, impact protection, and chemical resistance.

## Key Topics

- TPR (Thermoplastic Rubber) impact protection
- Durahide leather construction
- HPPE (High Performance Polyethylene) cut resistance
- EN 388 safety standards
- ANSI cut resistance levels (A4, A7, A9)
- D3O padding technology
- TrekDry comfort material
- SpeedKnit™ technology
- M-Pact® impact series
- Original® glove line
- Chemical resistance & nitrile coating
- Touchscreen-capable fingertips
- Abrasion-resistant materials
- Machine-washable construction
- ArmorCore protection

## Signature Glove Series

- [The Original® - Brown](https://www.mechanix.com/au-en/gloves/MG-07.html): Brown Original gloves with CoolPlus & touchscreen-capable fingertips
- [The Original® Hi-Viz](https://www.mechanix.com/au-en/gloves/SMG-91.html): High-visibility Original gloves with CoolPlus & touchscreen capability
- [M-Pact® - Black](https://www.mechanix.com/au-en/gloves/MPT-58.html): Black M-Pact with TPR impact protection, D3O padding & Ripstop fabric
- [Leather Original®](https://www.mechanix.com/au-en/gloves/leather-gloves/LMG.html): Classic Durahide leather Original gloves with TrekDry & TPR closure
- [Leather M-Pact®](https://www.mechanix.com/au-en/gloves/leather-gloves/LMP.html): TPR impact-resistant leather M-Pact with EN 388 rating & TrekDry

## Leather Work Gloves

- [Leather Driver F9-360](https://www.mechanix.com/au-en/gloves/leather-gloves/LD-C.html): Durahide leather driver gloves with Kevlar stitching & ArmorCore
- [Leather Rigger F9-360 Long Cuff](https://www.mechanix.com/au-en/gloves/leather-gloves/LDLC-X75.html): ANSI A9 long cuff rigger gloves with ArmorCore 5 & Durahide leather
- [Leather M-Pact® Driver F9-360](https://www.mechanix.com/au-en/gloves/leather-gloves/LDMP-C.html): Impact-resistant leather M-Pact driver with TPR & Durahide
- [Leather FastFit®](https://www.mechanix.com/au-en/gloves/leather-gloves/LFF.html): Durahide leather FastFit gloves with TrekDry for quick on/off
- [Leather M-Pact® Fingerless Framer](https://www.mechanix.com/au-en/gloves/leather-gloves/LFR.html): Fingerless framer gloves with TPR impact protection & Durahide leather
- [Flux - Torch Welding Series](https://www.mechanix.com/au-en/gloves/leather-gloves/WS-FLX.html): Durahide leather Flux welding gloves with FR Cotton & HiRoller tech

## Chemical & Cut Resistant Gloves

- [SpeedKnit™ Chemical S2EP02](https://www.mechanix.com/au-en/gloves/chemical-resistant-gloves/S2EP.html): ANSI A4 chemical-resistant SpeedKnit with HPPE and nitrile coating
- [SpeedKnit™ M-Pact® Chemical S5EP02](https://www.mechanix.com/au-en/gloves/chemical-resistant-gloves/S5EP-02.html): Impact & chemical-resistant SpeedKnit M-Pact with TPR protection
- [SpeedKnit™ M-Pact® S77DQ58](https://www.mechanix.com/au-en/gloves/chemical-resistant-gloves/S77DQ-58.html): ANSI A7 waterproof SpeedKnit M-Pact with impact & cut protection
- [8 Mil Nitrile RDT Gloves (Pack of 100)](https://www.mechanix.com/au-en/gloves/chemical-resistant-gloves/D01-09.html): 8 Mil Nitrile RDT disposable gloves with Raised Diamond Texture
